character.name: Tera
character.desc: A debt collector. Uses <c=status>TAX</c> to damage enemies and <c=status>BAILOUT</c> to avoid negative statuses.

tax.name: Tax
tax.desc: On end of turn, deal <c=keyword>1</c> damage for every <c=keyword>3</c> <c=status>TAX</c>.

persistence.name: Persistence
persistence.desc: Increase <c=status>TAX</c> by {0} at the start of turn.

AOverthink.title: Overthink
AOverthink.desc: Discard a <c=card>Ponder</c> in hand, or in the draw pile.

TaxEvasion.name: Tax Evasion
TaxEvasion.desc: <c=downside>Spend 1 enemy tax</c> to gain 1 <c=status>evade</c> and 2 <c=status>temp shield</c>.
TaxEvasion.descA: <c=downside>Spend 1 enemy tax</c> to gain 1 <c=status>evade</c> and 3 <c=status>temp shield</c>.
TaxEvasion.descB: Gain 1 <c=status>temp shield</c>. <c=downside>Spend 1 enemy tax</c> to gain 1 <c=status>evade</c> and 1 <c=status>temp shield</c>.

TaxExemption.name: Tax Exemption
TaxExemption.desc: Gain <c=status>shield</c> equal to enemy <c=status>tax</c>, then <c=downside>remove 1 tax</c>.
TaxExemption.descB: Gain <c=status>temp shield</c> equal to enemy <c=status>tax</c>, then <c=downside>remove 1 tax</c>.

Overdraft.name: Overdraft
Overdraft.desc: Shoot for <c=attack>{{damage}}</c> dmg. <c=downside>Spend 1 enemy tax</c> to shoot again for <c=attack>{{damage}}</c> dmg.
Overdraft.descA: Shoot for <c=attack>{{damage}}</c> dmg. <c=downside>Spend 1 enemy tax</c> to shoot again for <c=attack>{{damage + 2}}</c> dmg.
Overdraft.descB: Shoot for <c=attack>{{damage}}</c> dmg. <c=downside>Spend 2 enemy tax</c> to shoot for <c=attack>{{damage}}</c> dmg three more times.

BuriedKnowledge.name: BURIED KNOWLEDGE
BuriedKnowledge.desc: At the start of combat, add 3 <c=card>Ponder</c>s to the discard pile.

Lexicon.name: LEXICON
Lexicon.desc: Whenever you gain a <c=card>Ponder</c> during combat, it is given the A or B upgrade, alternating.
